description: Open the ACCDB catalog fixture read-only as the default Admin. Read MSysObjects through SELECT * (field metadata and every row), every TableDef's Name and Attributes, the MSysObjects TableDef's Fields (Name, Type, Size, Attributes, OrdinalPosition) and Indexes (Name, Primary, Unique, Clustered, IgnoreNulls, index fields), and then try SELECT * on each of MSysACEs, MSysQueries, MSysRelationships, MSysAccessStorage, MSysComplexColumns, MSysResources, MSysNavPaneGroups, MSysAccessObjects (each open's outcome, field metadata and rows).
retentionNote: Designed r-cat-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
